assets.prompt: Create an exceptionally polished, art-directed luxury collectible campaign flyer, landscape 3:2 composition, extremely high visual quality and gorgeous cinematic 3D rendering. This is a visual advertising campaign starring the exact seven Sanrio collectible models shown on image 1, not an information slide. Image 1 is the real product box and shows all seven character designs, and images 2–5 are detailed model references for Hello Kitty, Cinnamoroll, Kuromi and Pompompurin. Strict designs: Hello Kitty in PINK dress and PINK bow; Cinnamoroll with very long soft white ears and blue bow; black Kuromi with pink skull; pink My Melody with white flower; green Keroppi in striped red/white shirt and black bow; golden plump Pompompurin with brown beret; black Badtz-Maru with white belly, yellow beak and yellow feet. Preserve recognizable head/body proportions and details; use beautiful smooth collectible matte materials, no fabric fur, no outfit changes. Exactly seven physical characters, all whole bodies visible, faces clear, no duplicates. Show one actual box elegantly behind the group, secondary to the characters; keep its existing design. Compose a dynamic dimensional luxury pastel-pink wonderland with sculpted satin ribbons sweeping diagonally, curved layered rose quartz and ivory display platforms, soft floating heart accents in deep background, subtly iridescent pearl surfaces, elegant tiny glints, physically realistic contact shadows and ambient occlusion. Hero Hello Kitty centered and largest in front; Kuromi left and My Melody right slightly behind; Cinnamoroll floating gracefully higher with ears extended like wings; Pompompurin, Keroppi and Badtz-Maru thoughtfully arranged on curved tiers, all identifiable. Purposeful depth, perspective, asymmetrical high-end campaign composition, tightly designed focal hierarchy, sumptuous lighting, luminous pink and cream key lights, delicate lavender rims, editorial detail, crisp subjects and subtle depth of field behind. Avoid a cheap flat lineup, square UI cards, list of products, and black corporate slide background. Typography must be minimal, beautifully integrated with art: small tasteful white 'VOOK' wordmark near upper margin; the only other text is 'COLEÇÃO SANRIO', in large sophisticated pearlescent dimensional lettering in the upper third. Title fully readable, not obscuring any character. No other text, system names, technology terms, plans, modes, features, price, payment icons, QR codes, em breve, fake partner logos or technical information. Premium toy brand campaign crafted by a top 3D art director. Strong visual impact, not a title on an empty background. Final finished flyer, no mockup frame.

Produce an exceptionally high-quality luxury 3D collectible advertising campaign flyer, wide landscape 3:2, finished art, for VOOK's Monster High collection. NOT a corporate information slide. Use image 1 Draculaura, image 2 Frankie Stein, image 3 Clawdeen Wolf, image 4 Cleo de Nile as strict design/outfit references; image 5 is the actual black and magenta product box. Show exactly these four featured collectible characters full length in confident age-appropriate fashion-doll poses, with every outfit faithfully preserved from references, recognizable faces/hair, slender doll proportions and no missing limbs. Beautiful polished 3D collectible rendering with accurate physical light and premium smooth doll surfaces, detailed fabric seams, laces and accessories, not live-action humans. Draculaura in the pink and black school outfit, pink vest, white skirt, pink lace-up knee boots and black/pink twin ponytails, main hero near front center. Frankie mint-green with white/black hair and blue/black plaid school dress, to her left. Clawdeen brown skin, auburn hair, wolf ears, black jacket with light purple furry collar and purple skirt to her right. Cleo tan skin, gold/brown hair and pale turquoise/gold mummy outfit behind right. One box from image 5 integrated behind the group on a tier, secondary, keeping its product branding. Atmospheric gothic fashion runway/cathedral hall with dark polished obsidian terraces, elegant stone arches, illuminated stained glass magenta and violet, small tasteful chains, a few softly defocused bats far behind, thin dramatic volumetric purple light shafts, reflective floor and exquisite contact shadows, deep rich black cherry tones. Strong dimensionality, gorgeous detailed set, sophisticated deliberate composition, cinematic editorial lighting, hot-pink edges and cool purple rim lights, crisp clear characters, remarkable visual impact. Keep faces friendly and expressive, no horror gore. Only external text: small elegant white 'VOOK' wordmark at top and large beautifully integrated 'MONSTER HIGH' in stunning silver and pink gothic couture title lettering. Do NOT add systems, plans, script details, lists, features, prices, QR codes, buy buttons, em breve, technical information, extra captions or a grid of boxes. Premium art direction matching an expensive collectible launch campaign. Make a fully designed flyer filled with cinematic visual storytelling, not empty background plus text. Keep every character's head, shoes and full body visible, generous safe margins.

Create an extraordinary premium collectible plush advertising campaign flyer, landscape 3:2 composition, cinematic 3D art direction and extremely high finish. Product: VOOK's How to Train Your Dragon plush collection. Image 1 is the corrected VOOK product box and shows the exact black Toothless plush and pearly white Light Fury plush prominently on its front; use those as strict visual references for the two main plush characters and preserve the VOOK box branding. Image 2 is the white tusked spiky Alfa plush, image 3 is the green two-headed Arrota e Soluça plush, image 4 is the blue/yellow spiny Tempestade plush, image 5 is the stocky brown/orange Batatão plush. Exactly six physical collectible plush figures: black Toothless with enormous green eyes and pearly white Light Fury with enormous blue eyes together as front-center heroes; the other four plush dragons in clear supporting positions on terraced dark basalt rocks, all fully visible, no missing wings, no duplicate physical figures, and the two-headed dragon counts as ONE plush. Preserve their very cute chibi proportions, recognizable colors and faces, large embroidered-looking eyes, soft felt/plush fabrics, subtle seams and fine soft fibers; they are plush collectibles, not realistic wild dragons, do not add hard scales or gigantic adult dragon anatomy. A stunning intimate fantasy display inspired by the cliffs of Berk, distant jagged islands and waterfall silhouettes softly out of focus, rich teal and emerald atmosphere, dramatic shafts of warm golden sunset backlight, glimmering fine suspended dust, cinematic mist kept behind characters, tasteful dark Nordic stone and velvet surfaces. Art-directed depth and perspective, beautifully arranged welcoming expressive plush characters, gorgeous realistic materials, rich contrast, sophisticated lighting with warm gold rims and cool teal fill, full bodies and paws visible, pristine product details, luxury campaign aesthetic and emotionally compelling scene. Show one VOOK black and burgundy collectible box behind the group, naturally placed and secondary, accurate to image 1. Minimal, beautiful typography integrated into the upper quarter: small white 'VOOK' wordmark and a superb bold elegant bronze/ivory fantasy title exactly 'COMO TREINAR SEU DRAGÃO' arranged in two lines, with DRAGÃO largest and the accent correct. No other external text. No system or script information, no plans, no features, no payment, no price, no QR codes, no CTAs, no em breve, no TrueBlood or TB branding. No corporate cards or feature tables. The image must feel like a top-tier collectible brand campaign, with meticulous 3D set design, strong visual storytelling and beautiful plush heroes.
